infotexts.talentdescription.ntsp_imadoctornota: Gain an additional percentage to Ranged Fire Rate and Melee Attack Speed equal to [skillpercentage]% of your surgery skill.
infotexts.talentdescription.ntsp_preventativepermi: The last person you ordered and ally(including yourself) within 6m gain gains [physicalresistance]% damage resistance and is less likely to suffer serious injuries.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_laststand: A good doctor should be able to heal not only others but also themselves. When dying, gain [base] + surgery skill × [multiplier] seconds of forced consciousness. After it ends, max health -15%, curable only at a medical clinic.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.tesp_laststand: Forced consciousness; blood pressure, heart rate and blood loss are stabilized.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.tesp_laststand_aft: The price of holding on: max health -15%. Race with Death cannot trigger while this debuff is active.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_firstaidtraining: Traumatic shock suffered during surgery is reduced by [traumashockresistance]%, and resistance to Neurotrauma is increased by [neurotraumaresistance]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_buff: Blunt force damage taken is reduced by [bluntresistance]%, and the chance of fractures is reduced by [fracturechance]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_crustyseaman: For [duration] seconds after taking a hit, heal [bleedheal] bleeding per second on every limb.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_implacable: When your vitality drops to 0, gain [base] + weapons skill × [multiplier] seconds of last stand: rapidly heal regular damage, stay conscious, +25% attack power, and cannot die from damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_implacable_amputa: On trigger, heals amputated limbs, fractures and dislocations; while active, cannot gain new amputations, fractures or dislocations.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_lastwave: After it ends, max health -20%, curable only at a medical clinic, plus a brief stun; Last Stand cannot trigger while this debuff is active.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.tesp_lastwave: The price of holding on: max health -20%. Curable only at a medical clinic.
infotexts.talentdescription.affiliationnew: Whenever you complete a mission without any crew members dying, your crew members gain an extra [extraexperience]% experience and [largegain]% increased maximum life, capped at [maxgain]%
infotexts.talentdescription.bountyhunter: Whenever you or an allied crewmember kills a monster, your crew gains additional marks equal to [percentage]% of the creature's maximum health.
infotexts.talentdescription.commendationsnew: Whenever you complete at least one quest, you will get [num] [itemname]. When you use [itemname] on other characters, it gives them [selfxpgain] experience.
infotexts.talentdescription.crafthighqualitypistol: Increase the quality level of handguns you make by [qualitybonus].
infotexts.talentdescription.deputynew: ‖color:gui.orange‖You‖end‖ and the nearby ‖color:gui.orange‖assistants‖end‖ within [num] meters get [skillbonus] ‖color:gui.orange‖helm‖end‖ and [skillbonus] ‖color:gui.orange‖weapons‖end‖ skills, and the upgrade speed of these two skills is doubled.
infotexts.talentdescription.factiondiscountnew: If you are on your submarine and it becomes at least [flooded]% flooded, you will remain fully conscious for [duration] seconds.
infotexts.talentdescription.figureheadnew: Replace [itemname1] with [itemname2], when you use [itemname2] on other characters, both you and him will gain [selfxpgain] experience. If his level is lower than [level], he is promoted to [level].
infotexts.talentdescription.lonewolfnew: Gain the following effects, doubled if no other crew members are within [num] meters nearby:
infotexts.talentdescription.quickdrawnew: If you haven't fired your handgun for [seconds] seconds, your next shot will deal [damage]% more damage, this effect can stack [num] times to allow consecutive shots.
infotexts.talentdescription.truckernew: Whenever you finish all your selected missions, Receive a Helm reward of [skillamount].
infotexts.talentdescription.uniquestrengthen: Whenever you open a container in a sunken ship for the first time, you have a [probability]% chance to find a special weapon. \nBy recrafting, special weapons can be upgraded to ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolormasterwork‖Masterwork quality‖end‖ and given special effects.
infotexts.talentdescription.yourreputationnew: When entering a new outpost you have positive reputation with, gain [amount] mk.\nDoubled for cities.
